summary: Iteration 3 backend testing: 10/10 tests passed. Verified real Norwegian taxi pricing, admin dashboard endpoints, admin role gating, driver-invitation lifecycle including approval flow, and Google auth session endpoint 401 handling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1120 lines and beginning to become large; consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, driver, trips) for maintainability.

CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine, but `set_auth_cookie` uses samesite='none'; secure=True — cookies won't be sent cross-origin anyway since credentials disabled. Frontend already uses Bearer header so cookie is essentially unused; consider removing to reduce confusion.
admin_approve_driver does not verify user exists — silently succeeds with 200 even if user_id is invalid or not a driver. Consider returning 404 if no match modified.
accept_driver_invite does not validate expires_at (only get_driver_invite does). An expired but unused invite can still be accepted. Recommend adding expiry check here as well.
In lifespan, admin seed does NOT update password if admin already exists (deviates from playbook guidance about idempotent seed_admin). If ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes, existing admin won't sync.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_driver_* users via invitation-accept flow during lifecycle test; users remain in DB (no delete endpoint) but harmlessly prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter3 backend features verified. Sample pricing sanity for ~1.5km Oslo trip: enkelt < ai-first < trygg < premium, all >=50 kr, premium>=120 kr; long-trip (Gardermoen) scales 3x+. Google session 401 works. Admin gating (403 for role=user) works. Full driver-invite lifecycle passes (create → get-info → accept → 410 reuse → login unapproved → 403 on /driver/pending → approve → 200).
